messages.subject: Interview confirmed - Senior Software Engineer (Perception Infrastructure)
messages.body:
Hi Sam,

Great news! My client, Helios Robotics, would like to interview you for their Senior Software Engineer (Perception Infrastructure) position.

The interview is on Friday, November 13, 2026 at 9:00 AM ET via Google Meet: a 60-minute coding session followed by a 45-minute behavioral interview with the engineering manager.

Best,
Maya Brooks
TalentBridge Recruiting
